light_description: Small-run handmade Japanese fuzz pedal by NIJUUNISEIKI LLC; product documentation describes a deliberately under-voltage/dead-battery-style 1960s garage-fuzz character with FUZZ, VOL and TONE controls.
Original flagship dual-gain overdrive; discontinued; later succeeded by Super FatsDrive.
2018 flagship successor; dual-gain overdrive with original Fat bottom-control function.
Fuzzy overdrive combining fuzz-like low end with overdrive; derived from Super FatsDrive high-gain mode.
Mid-rich high-gain overdrive with proprietary ST control.
City Pop/A.O.R.-oriented overdrive with proprietary EDN control.
High-gain overdrive/distortion with frequency-selective Accel function.
Texas-style power-crunch overdrive; later upgraded to Fats Crunch DX.
Upgraded Fats Crunch with side gain-up switch.
Historical booster; discontinued and superseded by Fats Bullet.
Successor to Fats Boost; not central dirt.
